description: This file defines the BankingService interface, which declares methods for managing customers, accounts, and transactions in a banking application.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface for banking operations including customer management, account handling, and transaction processing.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with the provided details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their unique customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer information for the specified customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer operation between accounts.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specific account.
